items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 19 June 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong wind at first.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure near Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects much of the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the south at first, veering west or southwest 2 to 4 overnight, becoming variable later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, falling slight overnight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain/drizzle/mist and areas of fog. Then becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain/drizzle/mist and very poor in fog.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, becoming north or northeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
